title: Mundravathu Kann
desc: A young woman trapped in her home accidentally records a horrific crime next door, triggering a dangerous game of cat and mouse as the killer tries to silence her.

title: Maayavi
desc: Abhes, a con man, kidnaps famous actress Jyothika in an act of revenge after she sends him to prison. As her family searches for her, Jyothika comes to understand Abhes' true character.

title: Thayagam
desc: Three escaped felons hijack a plane carrying a scientist, but the pilot lands in Kashmir. Later, chaos unfolds when a terrorist hunts them down, seeking the scientist.

title: Success
desc: Ganesh lives a carefree life until his sister is insulted by Shweta's family. Unable to see his sister upset, Ganesh decides to take revenge against Shweta.

title: Unnidathil Ennai Koduthen
desc: Selvam and Bhaskar, two thieves with good intentions, hide with the help of Radha who is an illegitimate child living with his father's family in the guise of a maid.
